workflows.note: Baseline workflows are first-class install artifacts (Phase 1.5). They are editable starting points, NOT immutable configuration: the installer downloads them once, never modifies them afterwards, and never overwrites a user-customized copy. In production the workflow JSON is delivered with each task via GPU Hub (task.params); installed copies serve the user's local ComfyUI (open/edit/debug) and offline use. A fresh official copy can always be downloaded separately under a distinct name without touching the user's version.
